name: SillyTavern Vector Storage
ontology_notes: Vectra JSON collections under user-data /vectors. Three uses: chat-message chunks, Data Bank/file chunks, World Info entry contents. Items are hashed text plus embedding. No typed facts. Chat messages stay in the chat file; vectors are an index.

ontology.evidence: extensions/vectors/index.js stores hash/text/index. Chat vectorization shuffles original messages, not summaries, into a 'Past events:' template. Data Bank is files. WI path hashes entry.content. No kinds.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Background synchronizeChat embeds new messages. User Vectorize All / Purge. Optional summarize-before-embed via Main API/WebLLM/Extras (summarize() in vectors/index.js). User attaches Data Bank files. Model does not decide what to store as a fact.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: rearrangeChat: query last `query` messages (default 2), skip if chat shorter than `protect` (default 5), insert up to `insert` (default 3) hits above score_threshold (default 0.25). setExtensionPrompt(EXTENSION_PROMPT_TAG). activateWorldInfo emits WORLDINFO_FORCE_ACTIVATE for similar WI entries. Disabled paths inject nothing.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Old message vectors remain until Purge. Summarized vectors still retrieve the original message. No overwrite of a fact.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Similarity vs recent query text. No timestamp filter. Retain# only protects the last N messages from being shuffled, not time.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Collection id is chat id, file hash, or world_${hash(world name)}. Speakers are concatenated as name: mes. No user vs character vs relationship collections.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: score_threshold, disable extension, keep_hidden. Official disclaimer: does not guarantee improved memory. Prompt-cache warning: dynamic prefix causes cache misses. No topic blocklist.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Any past message that embeds near the query is eligible, including jailbreak attempts stored as chat. include_wi can let injected chunks trigger WI. No provenance.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Purge Vectors for current chat or files. Deleting a chat does not automatically document vector file cleanup in the user-facing chat-vectorization page (vectors live in /vectors).
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: One embedding query per generation plus embeds for new messages. Optional extra LLM summarize per message if summarize/summarize_sent. File RAG reserves context before fitting chat (data-bank.md). Defaults insert=3, query=2, message_chunk_size=400 chars.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Vectra on disk. Local Transformers default jina-embeddings-v2-base-en, or Ollama/llama.cpp/WebLLM. Cloud embed APIs optional. AGPL-3.0.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No MCP server. Extension API only.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Official docs say this does not guarantee better memory. It shuffles similar past chat text into the prompt. That is RAG, not a companion who knows when to stay quiet or how the relationship changed.
open_unknowns: Whether purge-on-chat-delete is implemented in server vector routes (not fully read).
